# The identifiers both providers accept and refuse, transcribed from the
# bash create-remote identifier guard.
#
# `/`, `#` and `@` are permitted MID-token: GitHub (owner/repo#42) and Trello
# identifiers legitimately carry them. The refusals are scoped to what breaks
# an unquoted YAML scalar written back into a work item's frontmatter.
#
# Format: <verdict> <TAB> <identifier, with \n \r \t \0 escaped>
# Verdicts: accept, empty, control, separator, comment

accept	PROJ-123
accept	ENG-4
accept	owner/repo#42
accept	a/b/c
accept	user@example.com
accept	5c9f2a1b-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
accept	ABC-1 with spaces
accept	trailing-dash-
accept	--not-a-separator
accept	ends-with-#
accept	 leading-space-then-text
empty
control	ABC-1\nDEF-2
control	ABC-1\rDEF-2
control	ABC-1\tDEF-2
control	ABC-\0-1
control	\nleading-newline
separator	---
separator	---ABC-1
separator	--- ABC-1
comment	#ABC-1
comment	 #ABC-1
control	\t#ABC-1
